hotel_1star_proxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Athens? Hotel Prices for Athens, Greece | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_proxy.evidenceText: Search snippet for the exact Athens hotel page reports: 'With data for 210 great hotels, the average price for 1-star hotels in Athens is $118, and the median price is $102.' It identifies the 1-star section as the average price for one night and the page states that hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes.
hotel_1star_proxy.taxEvidence: The same search snippet states: '(All hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes, and come from a base price that is reported by Kayak.)' The star-rating summary also says prices are before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_proxy.referencePeriod: Search result crawled last week; search-snippet evidence only, no page read.
hotel_1star_proxy.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Athens Greece 1-star hotel average price one night before taxes
hotel_1star_proxy.reason: Labelled source-level proxy candidate only: exact-city one-star USD one-night statistic and tax basis in the first snippet, paired with same-source exact-city double-occupancy wording in the second snippet. Search snippets are weaker than page evidence; never treat as observed or map/fit.

double_occupancy_semantics.sourceTitle: Athens Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Athens: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
double_occupancy_semantics.evidenceText: Search snippet for the exact Athens destination page states: 'The average price paid in Athens for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $144 (€126).' It identifies the one-person sharing-room value as $72 per night and says these costs are from reported spending of actual travelers.
double_occupancy_semantics.occupancyEvidence: Explicit search-snippet wording names two people and a typical double-occupancy hotel room.
